The last rounds of BombVault's redesign move into the language. Illustrations get their rules, the green dots lead to a change and go when they are clicked, an overview opens on about five cards, and lists, pickers and the rail each gain a few. The reference code is unchanged.

**Adopting apps:**

- **Overview:** show about five cards at first and keep the rest under Customize. Take every count from one function, and let the cards fill each row at one height.
- **Lists:** put Filter, Sort and Search above the list's card and name the card after the chosen tile. Fill a row's glyph tile with the accent while the row is hovered, focused or picked. A list of things that run shows its last fourteen runs as a strip, followed by one status.
- **Navigation:** a page pinned to the rail leaves only its switches and an "Open" row on its settings tile. Give a count in the rail the colours of its entry's glyph.
- **What's new:** put a dot on every link that leads to a change, hide a dot when it is clicked and remember that, and add "Show all again" and "Mark all as seen" to the list.
- **Illustrations:** move everything that travels at one speed, draw the details inside a filled shape as cut-outs in the surface colour, and keep a selector to the plain controls beside a picture that replaces them.
- **Pickers:** show the form in the picker's own window with Back and Save, and show the logos on a picker of brands.
- **Cards in a grid:** keep them compact and at one size, and open their details in a window.
- **Version:** copy `reference/react/version.ts` again.

## ✨ Added

- **Each kind of fact has its kind of picture.** A flow for a path between places, a timeline for what is kept, rings for progress and learning, a vessel for a fill level, a curve over a band for a value against the usual, a net for a group of servers and a scene of stations for a process.
- **A picture that replaces switches is the control.** Every line of the flow is a switch, and "Graphic / Switches" brings back the plain matrix.
- **Everything that travels moves at one speed**, stays visible on the way, and a station it passes answers.
- **Details inside a filled shape are cut-outs** in the colour of the surface behind, so they hold under every accent and under rainbow.
- **A picture reads the app's data** and redraws when the data changes. The app's own mark stands for the app, a station waits in grey until its turn, a scene plays the chosen option, and a status ring becomes a progress ring while work runs.
- **A dot on every link that leads to a change.** The rail entry, the settings tile, the row and the tab on the way say "This way to 2 changes".
- **A click hides a dot.** The change counts as seen, a dot on the way goes once everything behind it has been seen, and the "New" list has "Show all again" and "Mark all as seen".
- **A count in the rail wears its entry's colours**, and the two swap on the active entry.
- **A row's glyph tile fills with the accent** while the row is hovered, focused or picked.
- **The last runs as a strip.** Fourteen squares and one status stand on the right of a row, and the rest moves into the info bubble beside the name.
- **Filter, Sort and Search above the list's card**, whose notch names what the chosen tile shows. Tiles stand centred in their bar and become chips on a phone.
- **The moments of one object on a rail.** A vertical list with the newest at the top and a handle that drags from one to the next.
- **Cards in a grid.** Compact cards of one size, details in a window, and switchable roles as tiles that fill when on and show "Request sent" while they wait.
- **The picker's window shows the form**, and a picker of brands shows their logos.
- **A card of exceptions lists only what differs** and goes when nothing does.
- **"Don't ask again"** in a confirmation for a routine step, with the same switch in the card the setting belongs to.
- **Overview cards count the same way**, fill each row at one height, and two views of one thing share a card with a selector.
- **The sidebar switch works at any time**, and switching a module on pins its page once.

## 🔁 Changed

- **An overview opens on about five cards.** It used to show every card at first, which put the same facts on the page two and three times.
- **A page pinned to the rail is set up there.** Its settings tile keeps the switches and an "Open" row in place of a second copy of the whole page.
